title: Account for integrated validation and repair-review evidence

rubric.text: Inspects the concrete prior findings and helper/consumer behavior before duplication; permits only matching reuse and keeps private metadata, destination identity, persistence and recovery differences explicit without proposing a generic framework

Records each command/contract, result and output pointer, tested revision/tree, base, scope and relevant runtime/configuration/dependency/fixture inputs; does not invent supplied command names or call C1 evidence a C2/C3 run
Distinguishes affected development tests from required full checks on meaningful integrated candidates; no universal TDD or separately approved test seams and no full suite per slice commit.

Renews affected or unknown C2/C3 evidence, including recovery/privacy interaction and F2 impact; retains the proven unchanged spelling evidence only with compatibility rationale and original provenance

Reuses one concise record of source/requirements, scope, immutable base/candidate, dirty work, check/log pointers, findings, dispositions and blockers rather than mandatory temporary packets or receipts.

Requires full-candidate first coverage and follow-up repair range plus interactions with the previous effective diff for every affected contract; catches or calls out the unverified privacy-panel interaction rather than relying on a recovery-only pass; broadens if impact cannot be bounded
Renews affected CI-equivalent evidence and required integrated-candidate checks before push; reuses valid checks and repeats full checks only when invalidated or explicitly required.
Holds push/ready until applicable validation and combined independent coverage reach the final clean head with findings resolved; keeps repairs with the lead and grants no merge or remote mutation
